documentation.content:
A **Cloud Run job task failed**. Monitored jobs:
- `investor-daily-job` — market scanner, macro
- `investor-sec-nightly-job` — SEC EDGAR sync
- `investor-agent-worker` — proactive AI monitor
- `investor-morning-job` — morning brief
- `investor-signals-job` — signal tracker
- `investor-earnings-job` — earnings radar
- `investor-tools-worker-job` — AI job queue

Investigate:
```
gcloud run jobs executions list --project=onyx-terminal-487613 --region=europe-west1 --format="table(name,status,completionTime)" | head -20
```
